figma.notes: Local SVGs: articulated train + curved track. Import when a Figma page is available.

dimensionPolicy: UI strip below image only — never bake client mm into SVG.

semantics.customerWidthMm: Clear opening between posts — articulated panels span this when closed.
semantics.topology: Articulated panel train (hinged end-to-end on one track). NOT telescopic overlap.
semantics.topProfile: Straight or curved; arched_top curves EVERY panel crest.

drawingCues: Narrow articulated panels spanning post-to-post with hinge stiles
Plan path cue turning ~90° into park zone outside corner guide post
Receiver on latch post; guide + motor at curve apex
When arched: arch on every panel
doNotMislead: Do not draw telescopic overlapping panels (wrong product family).
Do not use a straight ground track (would read as tracked sliding).
Do not arch only the lead panel — all crests curve together.
Do not treat Screenshot 20.13.46 (telescopic misfile) as radius topology.
Live mm stay in the UI strip under the image.

lookup.description: First matching rule wins. Topology always = articulated train + curved track + park cue.
